Decrement timed powerup/health-refill counters, periodically invoke banked feedback services, and add health during refill. Copy player world position/flags into its actor slot, with an optional X-page adjustment from $06D9. Motion state9 schedules a table-driven effect from the low X coordinate and a $20-frame counter; finish by selecting player animation.

regions.summary: The first32 bytes are sixteen volume and sixteen pitch offsets for custom effect32. Music data starts at CPU $9B56:21 instrument control bytes,21 envelope pointers and21 lengths precede packed envelopes. Song records1..10 are eight bytes (four section pointers) at $9BBF..$9C0F. Selection0 overlaps the last envelope and is disabled by MusicActive=0. The traversed payload contains40 section lists,40 phrase lists and342 duration/note/control streams: section high-zero words control flow; phrase high0 advances and high1 repeats; note duration0 ends, otherwise entries have three bytes including $FF control records. Phrase index doubling carries into the high address, permitting256 words. The final duration-zero byte at $B978 is also tempo selector0; eleven tempo bytes finish at $B983. Original instrument/song titles and linker object boundaries are unknown.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

units.summary: Toggle the horizontal nametable bit, reset the local X position and advance the source selector for the remaining tile pairs.

regions.summary: Preserve X/Y and build a nineteen-metatile horizontal strip only at the required camera alignment. Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

Save camera/row state, choose upper/lower tile planes and resolve row/column pointers; ordinary and wide records consume one or two source bytes. Split VRAM records at nametable boundaries. Then build ten packed attribute bytes from neighboring metatiles, combining the appropriate two-bit quadrants and making a second pass for the other row half. Terminate the command with$FF, set the pending flag and restore saved coordinates. The adjacent reverse-column entry decrements the stream position and chooses column construction from its low-nibble phase before joining the shared register-restoring return.

units.name: R4BuildReverseScrollingColumn
units.summary: Preserve X/Y, decrement stream position and build the appropriate column when its low-nibble phase is3 or13; join the shared register-restoring return.

Remaining fields are type, frame/variant, state, flags and update mask. Flags $F0..$FF inherit facing from SpriteFlags. Clear per-slot counter/auxiliary state; low slots also consume direction, magnitude and extra mover byte. Caller contracts determine which record form is valid.

editorial_audit.notes: Final editorial acceptance: reused valid full-current-source reviews and checked the full physical inventory and affected sound27/allocator dependencies. Corrected RAM operands accidentally using controller-mask symbols to shared zero-page scratch aliases, including the D933 dispatch pointer and geometry source pointer; exact values preserved. Known structural and semantic uncertainties remain explicit. See editorial-audit.md. Classification remains incomplete: 34 bytes / 28 ranges unknown. Normalized review source references relative to commentary/source as required by the audit. Populated required per-Code scaffold unit records from existing reviewed block summaries and exact physical bounds; preserved top-level meaningful units and earlier embedded units. Associations retain full existing meaningful-unit physical bounds; otherwise use the already reviewed contiguous source Code block, rather than per-instruction units.

units.name: R4ScenePair0EntryStubs

units.name: R4InitializeSceneClass0
units.summary: Select the supported MMC1 control mode, load scene resource 0 and clear scripts. Set the horizontal scroll origin, copy eight palette bytes and initialize color ramps; default the substage and continuation count.

units.name: R4InitializeSceneClass1
units.summary: Select the fresh-start resource or rebuild the current substage. Remaining lives, continuation count and substage choose the pending scene request. Clear the local script state, install the two palette strips and initialize their ramps; active substages also initialize their secondary state.

units.name: R4InitializeSceneClass2
units.summary: Load CHR selection 2, install the alternate sprite descriptor and clear scripts. Copy its twelve-color strip and initialize the palette interpolation state.

units.name: R4InitializeSceneClass3
units.summary: Choose resource 3 or the shared resource for substage 3, then install descriptor and script state. A substage-indexed pointer and pending scene request select the later sequence; copy its palette strip and update palette targets.

units.name: R4InitializeSceneClass4
units.summary: When lives remain, initialize resource 2 and its palette ramps, select the stored text pointer and request scene 1. With no lives, transfer to the terminal resource initializer. A zero substage becomes 1.

units.name: R4InitializeTerminalSceneResource
units.summary: Load resource15, clear scripts, hide four OAM entries and initialize the terminal palette ramps. Set the pending scene request and continuation count before returning.

units.name: R4UpdateSceneClass1Frame
units.summary: Update scrolling and frame gates first; a gated or held scene skips the simulation. Otherwise update input, banked actors, local sequence selection, sprite state and scene scripts in that order.

units.name: R4ContinueSceneClass2Frame
units.summary: Continue only when the preceding frame gate is clear. Update input and actors, select the local script, then update sprite/script state; every fourth frame advance palette slot $19.

units.name: R4SelectSceneClass1Script
units.summary: Install a script only when none is active. Substage, remaining lives and continuation count choose one of four pair-4 script pointers; a continuation consumes one count, restores three lives and adjusts the local pointer byte.

units.name: R4SelectSceneClass2Script
units.summary: When no script is active, set a one-frame delay and install pair-4 stream A96F. The constructor, rather than the pointer setter, establishes its script bank.

units.name: R4ContinuePaletteActorCreation
units.summary: Restore a stacked palette value and initialize two palette entries, then allocate an actor. On success set its type/flags, choose one of two coordinate pairs randomly and initialize its timer and coordinate high bytes.

units.name: R4InitializeSceneClass5
units.summary: Build gameplay scene class 5 with script bank 0 (physical 0/1), collision root 94ED and sprite descriptor 8BD0. Install callback pointers, allocate the zero-terminated initial actor list, initialize player coordinates/camera state and transfer to the bank-8 scene initialization trampoline. The checkpoint flag controls the life/default transition setup.

units.name: R4ContinueScene5AlternateFrame

units.name: R4AdvanceScene5FramePhase

units.name: R4RebuildScene5PageAndDispatch

units.name: R4RebuildScene5PageState

units.name: R4AdvanceScene5TransitionScript

units.name: R4InitializeSceneClass6

units.name: R4RebuildScene6PageAndDispatch

units.name: R4UpdateActorTimedMovementMode
units.summary: Idle actors use the existing approach helper; active modes step movement and count down a randomized duration before clearing their low state bits.

units.name: R4UpdateActorTimedPosePair
units.summary: Update the movement mode and choose active or idle pose pairs through the actor base plane.

units.name: R4SetActorPose2AParameters
units.summary: Select variant2, sprite parameter8E and pose2A.

units.name: R4SetActorPose2FParameters
units.summary: Select variant0, sprite parameter90 and pose2F.

units.name: R4UpdateActorSubstageMotionPose
units.summary: Update timed motion, choose substage-dependent movement mode and resolve the active/idle pose pair.

units.name: R4UpdateActorAlternateTickMovement
units.summary: Step active motion only on the selected frame phase; randomize its timer when it expires and clear the low state bits.

units.name: R4ReplaceActorFromPlayerYPhase
units.summary: Run the shared actor update until its countdown and pose permit replacement, then derive a four-way effect selector from player screenY.

units.name: R4UpdateActorBoundedWorldXMotion
units.summary: Run the four-phase mover, choose an attack mode near the reference and use per-record low/high X limits to leave that mode.

units.name: R4ConstructRandomizedActorCoordinates
units.summary: Clamp a masked random sum, fold it into a signed camera-relative world-X offset and set Y to0101. Complete static actor-slot contract; natural calling values remain unresolved.

units.name: R4CreateFactoryLinkedActor16
units.summary: Find the source actor by pose, adjust its flags/type for the world page and allocate the linked type16, then initialize three palette ramps.

units.name: R4CreateFactoryActor17
units.summary: Allocate type17 at the fixed world coordinates and initialize its three palette entries.

units.name: R4SpawnFactorySelectorInterval
units.summary: Find the first of39 records at or above A and instantiate each selector through the inclusive callerX limit, stored internally asX+1.

units.name: R4CreateActorFromSpawnPlanes
units.summary: Load the selected coordinates/type and preserve the record index across allocation; on success copy sprite/state/height fields and return carry set.

units.name: R4CreateFactoryActorAndSaveSelector
units.summary: Call the common factory allocator, retain the source selector and copy the spawnY parameter to its target-height field.

units.name: R4SwapPlayerRequestInventory
units.summary: When the reserve count is nonzero exchange primary/reserve counts and request types.

units.name: R4CreatePlayerRequestActor
units.summary: Allocate a high-slot request actor, copy player position and opposite facing, and return carry success.

units.name: R4CreatePlayerVectorRequestActor
units.summary: Allocate a low-slot request actor, copy player fields and reflect the supplied direction bytes by facing before magnitude70.

units.name: R4CreateSceneColumnActor18
units.summary: Allocate type18 at callerX/Y coordinates with world page24, emit paired local effects when visible and set three palette entries.

units.name: R4UpdateSceneColumnActor18
units.summary: Rise by3 until low-byte borrow, pause sixteen ticks, then descend by4. At the bottom emit the local effect if visible and remove.

units.name: R4UpdateActor19ScenePointerAnimation
units.summary: While the scene pointer is nonzero, animate two poses and flip facing every32 frames.

units.name: R4UpdatePlayerRelativeActor1A
units.summary: Choose pose by magnitude; at the far X trigger one scene effect, update counters and clear its packed scene cell before removing.

units.name: R4ClearPackedSceneCell
units.summary: Split the caller cell index across two scene bytes and clear its bit through the mask plane, preserving A.

units.name: R4QueueOneTileAtActor
units.summary: Convert the actor coordinates to a tile destination, combine caller high flags and queue the supplied single tile while preserving actorX.

units.name: R4UpdateActor22TimedTransform
units.summary: At expiry transform using its selector and emit requests; otherwise enforce bounds and periodically choose pose/position offsets from the lookup planes.

units.name: R4UpdateShortEffectPoseCountdown
units.summary: Remove at timer expiry; otherwise derive one of four poses from the timer high bits.

units.name: R4UpdateActor1CTimedInteraction
units.summary: Advance facing/pose at timer thresholds and test contact before selecting the scene effect and request1F.

units.name: R4RunActorCommandContactRequest
units.summary: If the common contact test permits, enqueue request13 and restore the bank.

units.name: R4InitializeActorFromFactoryScratch
units.summary: Save actor coordinates into spawn scratch, instantiate record5 and set the resulting phase/sprite fields.

units.name: R4SetActor1CLeftPreset
units.summary: Select flags43 and X2D before the shared fixed-position type1C initializer.

units.name: R4SetActor1CRightPreset
units.summary: Select flags3 and X6B before the shared type1C initializer.

units.name: R4ResetActorToType1B
units.summary: Set type1B, fixed pose31 and normal sprite parameter, clearing its timer.

units.name: R4SetActor20VectorMagnitude
units.summary: Normalize flags, clear the base parameter and change type to20, then apply magnitude20.

units.name: R4CreateTransientActor25
units.summary: Allocate a low slot from the caller actor, copy its fields, offset Y upward4 and choose a facing-reflected random vector/magnitude.

units.name: R4UpdateTransientActor25
units.summary: Steer on the selected phase until reaching the Y limit or interaction; emit paired effects, update counters and remove as required.

units.name: R4UpdateActor26SpawnCycle
units.summary: High scene pressure animates/departs; otherwise sample the live-slot count every16 phases and spawn when the selected pose reaches4B.

units.name: R4UpdateActor0EAtYLimit
units.summary: At YC0 transform into the timed actor27 state, or remove if the transition fails.

units.name: R4TransformActorToTimed27
units.summary: Set type27, pose39 and timer24, clear both vector components and return carry success.

units.name: R4UpdateTimedActor27Spawn
units.summary: Animate three timer phases, then choose and instantiate a bounded random child and remove the parent only after success.

units.name: R4UpdateActor28FacingAndContact
units.summary: Choose its animation/facing from motion, periodically compute a player-relative direction and run the shared contact helper unless held.

units.name: R4CreateTypedLowSlotActor
units.summary: Allocate the requested type with callerY base parameter, initialize default flags/timer/vector and return success.

units.name: R4ChoosePlayerRelativeDirectionSector
units.summary: Compare signed world-coordinate differences against the player and store one of four diagonal direction sectors.

units.name: R4PlaceActorAtCameraSide
units.summary: Merge random facing and choose an actor world-X position on one side of the camera, with carry-aware high-byte arithmetic.

units.name: R4RemoveActor2BWithoutContact
units.summary: Retain the actor only while the shared contact condition succeeds.

units.name: R4UpdateActor2CTimedPoses
units.summary: Advance pose at timer32/16 and remove at expiry.

units.name: R4UpdateActor2ETimer
units.summary: Decrement the timer and remove at zero.

units.name: R4UpdateActor2FTimer
units.summary: Decrement the timer and remove at zero.

units.name: R4UpdateActor30TimedDescent
units.summary: Advance poses at timer32/24/16; in the final phase add4 to Y-low and remove when the timer expires.

units.name: R4UpdateActor2DFinalPose
units.summary: At timer4 advance the pose, then count down to removal.

units.name: R4Actor31NoOp
units.summary: Return immediately for actor31.

units.name: R4InitializeSceneInSelectedBank8
units.summary: Run selected CHR template10 before the shared display/phase initialization.

units.name: R4InitializeBank8DisplayPhase
units.summary: Extend blanking, run the two display templates, enable display configuration and clear the scene dispatch phase.

units.name: R4ComputeBank8SceneConfigurationIndex
units.summary: Add the checkpoint flag to the substage-indexed base. The supported entry precondition excludes interpreting the preceding JMP operand as a table cell.

units.name: R4LoadBank8SceneCameraConfiguration
units.summary: Load the selected camera/resource planes, recompute row division and synchronize player world coordinates.

units.name: R4DispatchBank8ResourceCopy
units.summary: Derive source parity and resource selector, then jump through fixedC00F with the current bank context.

units.name: R4UpdateBank8TimedEffect11
units.summary: Clear displacement, count down and emit request1F plus the common effect when its timer expires.

units.name: R4UpdateBank8TimedEffect12
units.summary: Test movement and apply interaction, then clear displacement and leave effect12 on expiry.

units.name: R4UpdateBank8Effect7Gate
units.summary: Clear displacement and clear the scene effect when its movement pattern byte reaches zero.

units.name: R4UpdateBank8ControllerState10
units.summary: Resolve held or scripted direction and collision flags into movement and scene effect4.

units.name: R4BuildReverseScrollingColumn
units.summary: Preserve X/Y, decrement stream position and build the appropriate column when its low-nibble phase is3 or13; join the shared register-restoring return.

units.name: R4ResetMmc1SerialRegisters
units.summary: Reset MMC1, select control1F and clear both CHR and PRG selectors through five serial writes each.

units.name: R4ClearPendingVramBuilders
units.summary: Clear queue indices and tile/attribute/command pending flags before CHR template upload.

units.name: R4ClearTrailingDecimalCounterDigits
units.summary: Clear six trailing digits and mark the leading counter flag before returning.

units.name: R4MoveScriptedPlayerDuringDelay
units.summary: Every fourth frame step left/right from the pattern bits while delay remains; advance the command on expiry.

units.name: R4AdvanceScriptedMovementPattern
units.summary: Shift the pattern by two bits, update scripted controller bits and reload delay7 or its saved default.

units.name: R4ApproachScriptedWorldXTarget
units.summary: Drive left/right until within the small final interval, then apply the screen-X correction, clear delay and advance.

units.name: R4CompareGeometryBoxes
units.summary: Normalize X-word distance and compare both axis distances against saturated extent sums. Carry set means overlap; nonadjacent high words fail early.

units.name: R4BeginInlineGeometryInterpreter
units.summary: Remove caller return into the program pointer, save callerX/Y and dispatch a command. Valid program storage and encoded continuations are caller contracts.

units.name: R4GeometryLoadIndirectBox
units.summary: Read X-word and Y through program-supplied pointers, then consume the two immediate extents.

units.name: R4GeometryLoadPlayerBox
units.summary: Construct the player box with pose-dependent extent and fixed offsets.

units.name: R4GeometryLoadForwardPlayerBox
units.summary: Construct the narrow forward player box with Y offset20 and fixed extents3/1.

units.name: R4GeometryFindActorTypeForward
units.summary: Read the type selector, search in the forward direction and continue only when an actor is found.

units.name: R4GeometryFindActorTypeReverse
units.summary: Read the type selector and use the alternate actor search; missing actors take the size-based skip path.

units.name: R4GeometrySelectSavedActorBox
units.summary: Use the saved actor slot, find its visible sprite request and construct its box. Missing visibility takes the program skip path.

units.name: R4GeometryLoadIndexedFieldBox
units.summary: Test the packed presence bit, load coordinate/base fields from the caller planes and resolve its extents through the shared box helper.

units.name: R4GeometrySkipMissingBoxCommands
units.summary: Skip program operands using the command-size table until a usable second box or terminator. Preserve the distinction between program offsets and CPU execution addresses.

units.name: R4GeometryCommitBoxAndCompare
units.summary: After box1 select the second scratch record. After box2 compare overlap, choosing its encoded success pointer or advancing past that word.

units.name: R4GeometryFinishAtProgramContinuation
units.summary: Advance the program pointer to its post-program continuation, restore caller X/Y and jump with carry clear.

units.name: R4TestForwardGeometryEdgeGap
units.summary: Compute the gap between selected box edges; gaps at least3 return, smaller gaps lead to relative actor allocation.

units.name: R4InitializeCounterOamEntries
units.summary: Build ten fixed-tile OAM entries from the attribute and Y planes.

units.name: R4IncrementScreenYWithCameraClamp
units.summary: Increment screenY and clamp it at80 unless the camera lock applies.

units.name: R4InitializePlayerRestartState
units.summary: Reset factory/player fields, choose a bank8 restart phase or pending scene from lives/checkpoint flags, and advance the restart script.

units.name: R4ReleaseSceneScriptFreeze
units.summary: Clear pause/freeze state and advance one command.

units.name: R4ApplyLifeLossWithOptionalLastLife
units.summary: Decrement lives with a zero floor; the debug/scene flag can preserve one life when the count reaches zero.

units.name: R4ClearNametable2400
units.summary: Select nametable2400 and join the shared1024-byte zero fill.

units.name: R4ClearNametable2800
units.summary: Select nametable2800 and join the shared1024-byte zero fill.

units.name: R4SnapshotFrontPaletteAndClearOverride
units.summary: Copy32 front colors into the back buffer and reset the override index.

units.name: R4InitializeFactorySelectors8Through9
units.summary: On first entry reset factory defaults, set step38 and instantiate selector8 through9; later frames return without repeating initialization.

units.name: R4InitializeFactorySelectors10Through11
units.summary: On first entry reset factory defaults and instantiate selector10 through11; the nonnegative active marker suppresses repeats.

units.name: R4InitializeFactorySelectors12Through13
units.summary: Initialize selectors12 through13 once, overriding the factory step to2C.

units.name: R4InitializeFactorySelectors15Through16
units.summary: Reset factory defaults and instantiate selector15 through16 once.

units.name: R4UpdateFactorySelectors17Through18
units.summary: Initialize selectors17 through18 once, then every32 frames permit spawning below the active-count limit. A type1 presence test and source selector choose the child; page parity sets its side and a random bit selects its height.

units.name: R4InitializeFactorySelectors19Through20
units.summary: Initialize selectors19 through20 once, overriding the factory step to2C.

units.name: R4UpdateFactorySelector21
units.summary: Initialize selector21 with default type6, update its linked actor and set active limit4. Use the shared phase check to choose subsequent typed spawns.

units.name: R4UpdateFactorySelectors22Through23
units.summary: Initialize selectors22 through23 with active limit3; every128 frames spawn from the retained record only when the pose9A search succeeds and count remains below the limit.

units.name: R4UpdateFactorySelectors24Through25
units.summary: Initialize selectors24 through25 with active limit3; use the same128-frame/count/pose gate for subsequent record spawning.

units.name: R4InitializeFactorySelector26AndLinks
units.summary: Initialize selector26 once, then create the type16 linked actor and the fixed-position type17 actor.

units.name: R4MarkFactoryInitializedWithoutSpawn
units.summary: Run the shared factory scene helper once and clear the negative initialization marker without selecting spawn records.

units.name: R4ContinueTileRowAcrossNametable
units.summary: Toggle the horizontal nametable bit, reset the local X position and advance the source selector for the remaining tile pairs.

units.name: R4BuildOrdinaryAttributePairs
units.summary: Combine quadrant bits from two neighboring ordinary metatile records into each attribute byte; this path uses one-byte map entries.

units.name: R4FinishOrRepeatAttributeHalf
units.summary: Complete the first attribute half, select the opposite quadrant bits and adjust the source row for the second pass before the shared terminator.

units.name: R4CommitRowCommandAndRestoreCamera
units.summary: Append the FF terminator, set command pending and restore the camera/row coordinates saved before construction.

units.name: R5ReleaseSceneActorVector
units.summary: Take the actor slot from vector cell 3, clear that cell to $FF, advance the actor state and start a two-tick script delay. The saved cell must contain a valid actor slot.

units.name: R5DeriveSignedSceneComponents
units.summary: Convert signed X and phase Y into the four component cells at $067E..$0681. The rescaled phase selects a positive or negative baseline; initialized finite shift/add loops approximate the remaining components. Units and original geometric purpose remain unresolved.

units.name: R5RewindSceneScriptWord
units.summary: Subtract two from the script pointer with explicit borrow, then return.

units.name: R5SelectScenePaletteCopyCount
units.summary: Supply count 15 to the following palette-copy setup; its source is $9079. The parallel entry uses $9069.

units.name: R5SetSceneState8AndGate
units.summary: Set scene state to 8 and arm the shared state gate.

units.name: R5ArmActor12RequestIfPresent
units.summary: Query actor type $12 and arm its request only when the query reports a match.

units.name: R5SelectSceneBooleanParameter
units.summary: Two entries select zero or one for the shared scene-field setter.

units.name: R5ConstructSceneActor0EAtPreset
units.summary: Run scene/actor setup, set parameter $C4 and tail into the constructor with type $0E and coordinates $A0/$28.

units.name: R5ArmAndConsumeStripeQueueRequest
units.summary: Entry presets supply selectors 0..6 to the common request setter. The consumer waits for an idle queue and pending bit, then clears that bit after installing a pointer. With Y=2 the positive path reads $A55D/E=$AB20; the negative path reads $A55F/60=$A000 from overlapping code. A usable queue on every direction is not established.

units.name: R5SelectQueueWordOffsets
units.summary: Three entries supply byte offsets 2, 4 or 6 to the idle-gated queue lookup. Valid complete pointer coverage and natural selector use remain unresolved.

units.name: R5LatchPlayerMiddleStripeCrossing
units.summary: Use the low nibble of player X to detect entry into the interval [5,11). Outside it, arm bit 7 of the latch; entering it clears the latch and flips the signed request state once.

units.name: R5SelectRandomOrFrameDirection
units.summary: Separate entries choose a random nibble, derive Y=0..15 from the frame word, or map that Y through the first direction permutation. The random and mapped results share the direction cell.

units.name: R5SelectSecondFrameDirection
units.summary: Derive the same frame index 0..15 and store the second permutation value as direction.

units.name: R5SetSceneParameter18Or48
units.summary: Two returning entries set the shared scene parameter to $18 or $48.

units.name: R5ClearSceneRequestAndAdvance
units.summary: Clear the request cell and advance the scene script.

units.name: R5ApplyRandomActorDirectionOffset
units.summary: Mask the random result to five bits and add $F0 using the returned carry, then update the current actor direction. This does not imply a uniform random distribution.

units.name: R5InstallSceneScriptAA69
units.summary: Install pointer $AA69 and continue the existing handler. The pointer setter does not select its script bank; physical pair 0/1 is required.

units.name: R5CreateSceneActor1D
units.summary: Allocate an actor, then initialize type $1D, flags 3, sprite $1E, world position and masked random coordinates with a $20 timer. Allocation failure returns without initialization; success returns carry set.

units.name: R5CreateMovingSceneActor1E
units.summary: Allocate a low slot and initialize type $1E with flags $42, sprite $25 and world coordinates. Apply the two motion components using the new slot; carry reports allocation success.

units.name: R5SelectComplementaryTriggerPaths
units.summary: Two entries test opposite signs of the trigger-state cell, selecting the shared trigger continuation or alternate path.

units.name: R5CopyScenePalette845D
units.summary: Two separate wrappers copy fifteen palette bytes from CPU $845D through the common copier.

units.name: R5CopyPaletteAndGatePlayerWindow
units.summary: Copy fifteen palette bytes from $846D. Separate entries set the scene parameter; the window helper sets player flag $20 only for X in [$66,$F8), clearing it outside.

units.name: R5SelectPanelRow1C
units.summary: Supply row $1C and parameter 6 to the shared panel emitter.

units.name: R5SelectConditionalPanelDestination
units.summary: Use row $11 and width $2C; when the signed gate is negative and the second gate is zero, install destination $21C0 before joining the shared emitter.

units.name: R5SelectPanelRow0A
units.summary: Supply row $0A and width $1E to the shared emitter.

units.name: R5DecrementSceneCounterDuringDelay
units.summary: Decrement the scene counter, then use the timer-conditioned script advance.

units.name: R5QueryActor0AAndAdvance
units.summary: Query type $0A through the existing actor service, then advance the script.

units.name: R5SetActor6Sprites1DOr1F
units.summary: Two script entries find type 6 and, when present, set all three sprite planes to $1D or $1F. Both found and missing paths advance the script.

units.name: R5SetActor6Sprites23Or24
units.summary: Two script entries similarly select $23 or $24 for all three sprite planes of type 6; missing actors still advance the script.

units.name: R5SelectActorParameter2
units.summary: Supply parameter 2 to the shared actor setter.

units.name: R5SelectActorParameter4
units.summary: Supply parameter 4 and fall through into the shared actor setter.

units.name: R5InitializeActorFromPlayerMode
units.summary: Copy player world coordinates and flags to actor X, update the actor control cell and choose sprite 7 or 8 from player mode and motion fields. The shared assignment also updates the sprite request. Requires a valid actor slot.

units.name: R5AdvanceActorPhaseOccasionally
units.summary: Run the shared field updater; every sixteenth frame a random sign test may advance the actor sprite phase. Continue with its low bit as the selector.

units.name: R5CreateActor0CWithSavedParameter
units.summary: Preserve input A across type-$0C allocation. On success store it in the per-slot parameter, initialize fields and position, and return carry set; failure restores the private stack value too.

units.name: R5HideActorWorldXPage
units.summary: Set the actor X high byte to the shared $FF hide sentinel.

units.name: R5AdvanceActorPhaseFromSecondarySprite
units.summary: Set the actor phase to one past its secondary sprite value.

units.name: R5UpdateActorSpeedAndClonePhase
units.summary: Speed tiers choose sprites $42..$44 and update motion. The slow/vertical path may clone the actor or convert it to type 5. The clone entry preserves the original slot across allocation and copies from it on success. A separate timer phase selects $49/$48/$47 and removes the actor after expiry.

units.name: R5TrackActorDisplacementAndSpawn
units.summary: For sufficient speed, feed doubled signed Y change to the modulo-$F0 page helpers and X change to the displacement helper, then save the new coordinates. Within Y [$80,$C0), save the original slot and call the allocator, which consumes the following eight inline bytes on both outcomes.

units.name: R5FinishTrackedActorSpawnAndSteer
units.summary: Pop the saved slot after inline allocation. On success use it as clone source and offset child Y by $12; failure recovers the saved slot in A and jumps to the return, leaving allocator fallback X unchanged. The steering path adjusts direction/speed, derives index 0..7 from direction bits and applies the sprite and facing tables.

units.name: R5AdjustTrackedPageAndActorWindow
units.summary: Independent entries add/subtract a modulo-$F0 page coordinate, subtract horizontal displacement, compensate actor X and update low flag bits, or remove an actor above the Y bound. Carry/borrow crosses the paired page bytes; valid actor and scene state are required.

units.name: R5RampActorToVerticalTarget
units.summary: Move Y toward the secondary-sprite target using the timer as speed, increasing speed every fourth frame up to 4. At the target, set request $37, compute relative coordinates and remove the actor.

units.name: R5StepPlayerHorizontalWord
units.summary: Separate increment and decrement entries update the indexed player X word with carry/borrow. X must identify a valid field slot.

units.name: R5IntegratePlayerVerticalSlot
units.summary: For slot Y=0..5, integrate nonzero velocity and signed acceleration through the existing component helpers. On target crossing clamp position, then stop or restore bounce velocity according to flag bit 2. The remaining path adjusts speed toward the configured bounds. Units remain mechanical.

units.name: R5TryPlayerOrientationAndExtractPose
units.summary: Two entries set orientation $40 or zero and attempt collision, selecting the existing success/failure continuations. A separate helper extracts bits 2..4 of the pose field into index 0..7.

units.name: R5ScaleWordByFifteenAndAddBase
units.summary: Compute a 16-bit result: fifteen times input A/Y plus the base word. Four shifts form sixteen times the input, subtraction removes one copy, and the base is added with carry.

units.name: R5EmitFourMapperBitsB000
units.summary: Emit four successive low bits of masked A to $B000. Four writes do not by themselves establish a complete MMC1 transaction; prior shift-register state matters.

units.name: R5EmitFourMapperBitsDFFF
units.summary: Emit four low bits of A to $DFFF and return. A complete mapper-register effect requires the appropriate prior serial state.

units.name: R5AdvanceRendererRowBudget
units.summary: Preserve the row accumulator while updating the secondary accumulator and decrementing the row budget. Repeat eight-unit steps until carry, or join the existing exhausted-budget path. Renderer scratch and incoming carry are preconditions.

units.name: R5GuardRendererUpperBoundary
units.summary: Reject values at or above $E8 through the shared boundary exit; otherwise continue row stepping.

units.name: R5DispatchRendererMaskCombination
units.summary: Test four stored masks to select the existing renderer paths. A carries the flag combination; X/Y and renderer scratch must satisfy the surrounding routine contract.

units.name: R5LoadThreeBytePointerDescriptor
units.summary: Read three bytes through input pointer A/X into the shared pointer word and descriptor field. The caller supplies readable storage.

units.name: R5LoadCHR6Template
units.summary: Save flags, A and Y, mask display state, disable the PPU and increment the renderer lock. Select CHR6 and enter the common template copier/restorer with X as template selector.

units.name: R5LoadCHR5Template
units.summary: Use the same balanced saved-register loader contract with CHR5. The common tail restores CHR/display/lock state and original Y/A/P; selector bit 7 chooses direct return or transfer to RAM $0200. Stored CHR bytes retain separate physical identity.

units.name: R5RunBankedRendererServices
units.summary: The first two entries save and restore the PRG selector around a renderer or template service. The template entry selects X=8, so its RAM $0200 template must return to the wrapper. The third entry independently selects physical pair 8/9, configures player sprite fields via $89C3 using the pose index, and restores the scene bank.

units.name: R5StepPageBackwardThroughBank8
units.summary: Below page $79 advance the script; otherwise decrement the page, select physical pair 8/9 and invoke its backward-page service plus the fixed continuation. Fall through to scene-bank restoration.

units.name: R5AdvanceScriptFromPageGuard
units.summary: Shared script-advance endpoint for the page guards.

units.name: R5StepPageForwardThroughBank8
units.summary: At page $87 advance the script; otherwise increment the page, select physical pair 8/9, invoke its forward-page service and restore the scene bank.

units.name: R5BeginPlayerCollisionWithSavedBank
units.summary: Save requested coordinates and compute player world state. The bypass flag returns carry set; otherwise push the bank selector and enter collision-bank selection, continuing through the existing bank-restoring path.

units.name: R5TestOrSetTriggerBitWithEscape
units.summary: The test entry requires X=0..7 and Y=0..15; a set bit discards its immediate caller return pair. The setter obtains X/Y from RAM $0540/$0595, which must satisfy that same mask domain, and privately saves Y. A duplicate bit discards that save and the caller pair. These exits require an outer return contract; the X>=8 path does not prove valid masks there.

units.name: R5GuardAndCommitPageTransition
units.summary: For signed transition pages, clear velocity fields when requested and select backward/forward services outside the central interval. Inside it clear transition flag $20 and return carry set. Committed transitions refresh player pose through physical pair 8/9 and return carry clear.

units.name: R5SelectActorAllocationOutcomes
units.summary: Independent search/allocation wrappers use their documented Z or carry result to choose the existing failure/removal or success continuation. The source record selector remains in A.

units.name: R5AllocateActorWithInlineRecord
units.summary: Attempt allocation, branch to the existing failure skip, or continue into the inline record reader. Its caller return address identifies the record.

units.name: R5StoreActorRecordHandle
units.summary: Store the two-byte A/Y handle in the shared actor-record pointer cells.

units.name: R5ActorCoordinateSpriteAndFacingUtilities
units.summary: Separate entries compare player/actor X, set all sprite planes, derive a bottom-edge flag from geometry, subtract/add X with borrow/carry, or toggle/set facing. The geometry entry replaces X and restores the actor slot from $064C, which must hold a valid slot.

units.name: R5PlaceActorAndTestFacingWindow
units.summary: Placement entries choose an offset from player/scratch orientation; the positive path adds $10 low and 1 plus carry high. Another entry adds scratch 7 to all sprite planes. The facing test returns carry set immediately for hidden page $FF. It saves flags, updates facing and checks a one-page displacement window; only the restore path at $E543 restores saved flags. Rejection may retain the facing mutation.

units.name: R5ResolveSpriteIndexAndSearchActors
units.summary: Separate entries move actor X by signed facing, resolve a sprite index, search forward high slots or backward slots, and blink Y from the frame bit. The resolver compares against the configured count in RAM $2C; built-in table safety depends on that count. Dynamic word indexing temporarily adjusts pointer high $2B only on carry and restores it afterward.

units.name: R5StepActorAndRetryGeometry
units.summary: Move actor X and Y by one. Compare returned A, the updated low Y byte, with $F0 and retry the existing geometry continuation when needed; otherwise fall through to blinking.

units.name: R5JoinActorBlinkUpdate
units.summary: Join the established blink/update routine. The adjacent isolated RTS bytes remain unknown.

units.name: R5ActorVerticalAndWindowUtilities
units.summary: Separate entries update sprite phase, subtract/add actor Y with word borrow/carry, clear motion fields, or compare a horizontal window with carry output. The Y helpers branch to $E5E1 on their no-borrow/no-carry paths; they do not target unknown $E5E6. Window arithmetic uses the incoming carry and shared scratch.

units.name: R5FrameMasksAndConditionalActorRemoval
units.summary: Four entries return the frame counter masked to periods 16/32/64/128. A separate actor-query wrapper returns when absent or removes the found actor.

units.name: R5CopyActorWorldCoordinates
units.summary: Copy all four world-coordinate planes from actor X to actor Y. Both indices must be valid slots.

units.name: R5InstallScriptOnlyWhenIdle
units.summary: Save input A and test the script high byte. Idle falls through after restoring A into the pointer installer; busy branches to the balanced pop-and-fail entry.

units.name: R5RejectBusyScriptInstall
units.summary: Pop the input A saved by the conditional installer and return carry clear.

units.name: R5AnimateBankPaletteAndRestartScene
units.summary: Independent entries alternate actor bank 5/3 during a timer, fade all 32 palette cells every fourth frame until black, or clear the script and restart scene setup. The restart path discards its caller return pair when the substage gate is clear; an outer dispatcher return is required. Otherwise it sets the scene request flag.

units.name: R5StartEightTickScriptDelay
units.summary: Start an eight-tick delay and fall through to script advance.

units.name: R5TestSceneStateAndEscapeCaller
units.summary: The predicate combines shared state flags with the two state counters, returning zero or $80. Its wrapper returns normally for zero and discards the immediate caller pair for a negative result; this requires the outer return contract.

units.name: R5RequestSceneOrAdvancePage
units.summary: Set the default request to 8, arm scene flag $20 and compare horizontal position to the boundary. A low page may advance through the page service; otherwise clear the script and tail into the scene-request service.

units.name: R5SetSceneControlBits
units.summary: Two entries set scene flag $10 or $20 through the common store. OR $20 is nonzero, making its branch to that store unconditional.

units.name: R5SelectSpriteRowStart0D
units.summary: Supply starting slot $0D to the fixed-size sprite-row loop.

units.name: R5SelectSpriteRowStart0A
units.summary: Supply starting slot $0A to the same sprite-row loop.

units.name: R5SelectActorDirectionMode82
units.summary: Supply mode $82 to the shared direction/mode setter.

units.name: R5SetSceneFieldAndAdvance
units.summary: Call the constant-field setter and then advance the script.

units.name: R5WaitByRewindingScriptWord
units.summary: While the script delay is nonzero, rewind its pointer by two with borrow. When the timer reaches zero, advance normally.

units.name: R5SetSceneParameter3Or8Or9
units.summary: Three script entries set the shared scene parameter to 3, 8 or 9, then advance.

units.name: R5SetSceneParameter2
units.summary: Set the shared scene parameter to 2 and advance.

units.name: R5SetSceneParameter0A
units.summary: Set the shared scene parameter to $0A and advance.

units.name: R5ReturnSceneStateMismatch
units.summary: Return one when any shared state flag is negative or the two counters differ; otherwise return zero.

units.name: R5LoadSceneDescriptorAndRunServices
units.summary: Restore the scene bank, select a word-directory entry using the doubled scene selector and read its seven-byte descriptor into page, position and resource fields. The selector sign controls one page store. Directory/pointer validity is a caller precondition. Separate entries clear/set player flag $20 or invoke fixed services before the existing continuation.

units.name: R5GetNextStageNumber
units.summary: Return the stage number plus one with byte wrap permitted.

units.name: R5CombineSceneStateFlags
units.summary: Return the OR of three state cells, including N/Z for the scene predicates; no state is modified.

units.name: R5OrderedSceneComponentBytes
units.summary: Thirty-two ordered and reflected bytes, between the completed component helper and script rewind. Nearby component consumers and the ascending/saturating pattern support noncode; the original coordinate schema is unresolved.

units.name: R5AdjacentQueueWordBytes
units.summary: Four generic data bytes encode adjacent words $AB8D/$AB20 beside queue storage. Only the second is selected by the Y=2 positive consumer; the negative consumer reads neighboring code. This is not a proven two-selected-pointer directory.

units.name: R5QueueWordAB20
units.summary: The little-endian word $AB20 is selected at offset zero by the preceding queue lookup. The next byte remains an ambiguous isolated RTS, followed by code.

units.name: R5FirstDirectionPermutation
units.summary: Sixteen direction values selected by the independently bounded frame-derived Y=0..15.

units.name: R5SecondDirectionPermutation
units.summary: Sixteen direction values for the second frame-derived permutation; the next script begins immediately after them.

units.name: R5DescendingWorldYCoordinates
units.summary: Six descending coordinate bytes consumed with the player world-Y page. The adjacent routine and initializer bound storage; a complete valid page domain is not established.

units.name: R5RepeatedFFParameterBytes
units.summary: Five $FF bytes between parameter storage and an independent code boundary. Original terminator or fill purpose is unresolved.

units.name: R5ThreePaletteColors
units.summary: Three colors selected by the immediately preceding bounded palette loop.

units.name: R5PaletteAnimationSequenceA
units.summary: Five palette-animation values selected by the neighboring consumer; the matching sibling and next code boundary support storage without a complete eight-value table claim.

units.name: R5PaletteAnimationSequenceB
units.summary: Matching five-byte palette-animation sequence. Some consumer indices may exceed this slice; no larger complete extent is inferred.

units.name: R5ActorSpriteAdjustmentsA
units.summary: Four sprite adjustments consumed by the neighboring phase logic.

units.name: R5ActorPhaseChoices
units.summary: Four phase values selected by the preceding phase comparison and lookup.

units.name: R5ActorSpriteAdjustmentsB
units.summary: Four sprite adjustments indexed by a masked two-bit phase.

units.name: R5FourActorSpriteChoices
units.summary: Four sprite IDs indexed by two bits derived from the scene counter.

units.name: R5FourFrameParameterChoices
units.summary: Four small values indexed by the shifted frame counter masked to two bits.

units.name: R5ActorParameterQuartet
units.summary: Four parameter bytes shared by neighboring actor consumers and repeated in the player bank. Their precise game meaning is unresolved.

units.name: R5TrackingActorSpawnRecord
units.summary: Eight-byte absolute actor record consumed inline by the allocator. The continuation pops the saved original X; these are not instructions.

units.name: R5TrackingSpriteAndFacingTables
units.summary: Two eight-byte planes selected by (direction & $70) >> 4: sprite choices followed by facing masks.

units.name: R5PlayerParameterQuartet
units.summary: Four parameter bytes selected by the preceding subtract-and-compare bound 0..3; identical to the actor quartet.

units.name: R5CoordinateLikeTailBytes
units.summary: Four coordinate-like bytes adjoining existing coordinate storage. Pattern and neighboring boundaries support noncode; the exact original table extent is unresolved.

units.name: R5RepeatedCoordinateSeparatorBytes
units.summary: Four repeated $22 bytes between coordinate storage and an independent code entry. Original storage purpose is unresolved.

units.name: R5SceneCollisionRootWord
units.summary: Collision-directory word $BCE4 installed by the scene initializer and consumed by the two-level collision lookup. This does not establish a complete page domain.

units.name: R5ResourceOriginRecords
units.summary: Two three-byte resource/origin records. The consumer uses carry to select offset zero or three and copies three fields; independent producer and next-code boundary establish the six-byte extent.

units.name: R5FourPackedFieldMasks
units.summary: Four masks $03/$0C/$30/$C0 selected by an independently bounded two-bit index.

units.name: R5NametableAddressLikeWords
units.summary: Four generic data bytes encode $2000/$2400 between a completed return and reset entry. No consumer or more specific directory role is established.

units.name: R5RendererPrefixAndBitMasks
units.summary: A generic leading $03 byte followed by four masks explicitly tested by the renderer branch tree. No selector schema is inferred for the prefix.

units.name: R5AdjacentTransitionHandlerWords
units.summary: Four generic data bytes encode the two neighboring transition-handler addresses. Their original consumer and complete stream layout remain unresolved.

units.name: Sound27ReturnCallback
units.summary: Sound27 no-update return callback installed through SetSoundEffectHandler and called through the slot-word dispatcher; Static, natural selection unresolved.
